facts.fact: Indian Railways' official PNR Enquiry page (indianrail.gov.in, linked as 'PNR Status' from indianrailways.gov.in) shows the current status when the PNR number from the ticket is entered
facts.quote: Enter the PNR for your booking below to get the current status. You will find it on the top left corner of the ticket.
139 – Integrated Helpline · Security Helpline or Medical Assistance ( 1 ) · Enquiry ( 2 )

summary: Coverage probe; the official channels it names are confirmed: Indian Railways PNR Enquiry page (indianrail.gov.in) and 139 enquiry option. Expected text unchanged.
